source_order: SG_SaveLocalPlayer resolves GetLocalPlayer(0,1), reads PlayerInfo+0x660, and delegates to SG_SavePlayer(Character*,false).
SG_SaveAllPlayer loops PlayerManager+0x6c4 players and calls SG_SavePlayer(index,force) for each.
SG_SavePlayer(index,force) validates the index, resolves GetPlayer(index,1), reads PlayerInfo+0x660, then delegates to the Character overload.

SG_SavePlayer(Character*,force) rejects absent or source-virtual-ineligible Character; remembers its blocked state; force temporarily unblocks; then writes player level, save date, Level+0x110 entry point and global difficulty before Character::SG_Save; restores the prior blocked state.
Character::SG_Save calls PlayerSavegame::SG_Save on Character+0x14e8. This is profile persistence, separate from per-level LevelSavegame INFO/OBJS.

PlayerSavegame::SG_Save runs its saved-section setup and Savegame::saveAll path; registered sections include PDFL,LNAM,LEPT,LUSP,LVLS,FAES,FTVL. Online volatile quest log packing is a separate conditional tail.
scope: Static source ordering for PlayerSavegame checkpoint dispatch; does not establish a live native provider, filesystem integration, gameplay transition, or Android validation.
